title: Seed users alice/bob created unconditionally with hardcoded password 'Pass123$', advertised on the login page
owner_hint: no CODEOWNERS entry; top committer: toyzoz / Rob Conery; component: Identity.API/
rationale: Gates UsersSeed.SeedAsync behind IWebHostEnvironment.IsDevelopment() (injected via the existing DI resolution path, mirroring CatalogContextSeed) so known-password demo accounts are only created in Development — migrations still run. Replaces the login-page credential hint with a neutral prompt. OPERATIONAL NOTE: databases previously seeded in non-dev still contain the accounts — rotate/delete them at deploy. e2e unaffected: the AppHost launch profiles set Development, and Playwright authenticates via env vars, not the page hint.
variants_checked: Three hardcoded-credential hits in Identity.API (both CreateAsync calls + Login.cshtml hint), all covered; no other IDbSeeder implementations.
bypass_considered: Only the exact Development environment name reaches seeding; the UI hint is removed for all environments; CI (ci.yml) does not run Playwright, and when it does, Development gating keeps seeding active.
test_note: Omitted — Identity.API has no test project; regression verified by inspection (no unit test touches the seeder; e2e unaffected as documented).
review_reason: Root-cause gate on the unconditional seeder plus defense-in-depth hint removal, both remediating one finding; DI pattern mirrors the repo's existing seeder.
